headline: Dangote plans undersea fuel pipeline and $2.5bn Namibia storage project
summary: Aliko Dangote is expanding his petroleum distribution footprint across Africa with plans for an undersea fuel pipeline to supply Ghana and Togo, alongside a $2.5 billion storage and pipeline project in Namibia.
why: Major downstream infrastructure investments reshape regional energy supply chains and logistics across African markets.

impacts.name: Oil & Gas
impacts.why: Cross-border petroleum infrastructure projects expand distribution networks and alter regional product flows.
